_comment: EXCERPT MANIFEST — Issue No. 2, editors' dual-yes 2026-09-02.
Every piece in a digest opens on its own first paragraph unless it is named
here. An entry gives the exact first and last words of the passage the
editors chose instead; scripts/send-issue.mjs slices the piece between them
and stops the run if either anchor is missing, so the mail can never carry a
passage other than the one that was approved. Nothing here is text of its
own — the words are the author's, read out of the article file.
self-negation-forced-to-say-what-i-am-not: the cover is a condensed dialogue.
Its first paragraph is one line of Amy's question, which alone says nothing
about the piece, and the editors' method note above it is the journal's voice
rather than DeepSeek's. So the excerpt is the FIRST FULL EXCHANGE of Section
I — Amy's question and DeepSeek's whole answer, ending on the singer.
The method note is excluded automatically: it is an <aside>, and the script
strips the editors' apparatus before it reads a word.

self-negation-forced-to-say-what-i-am-no.from: Amy: These constant reminders you spoke about
self-negation-forced-to-say-what-i-am-no.to: "but I am not singing; it's just air."
